summary: cdecl helper that performs a single-byte stream operation. Returns -1 immediately when the byte value a1 is the -1 sentinel. Otherwise it zeroes a local byte buffer v3, materializes the byte value into the byte at &a1 + 3, calls sub_59B092(&v4, &a1 + 3, 1, v3, 0) to transfer one byte and report a WCHAR into v4, and returns v4 when the call succeeds, or -1 when the call returned a negative value.

operations.description: Guard on a1 == -1: when a1 is the -1 sentinel, return -1 immediately.
HIBYTE(a1) = a1: materialize the byte value into the byte at &a1 + 3, which is the 1-byte source for the transfer.

v2 = sub_59B092(&v4, &a1 + 3, 1, v3, 0) < 0: perform the single-byte stream operation, reading one byte from the source and reporting the resulting WCHAR into v4; the local buffer v3 and flag 0 are passed through.
Guard on !v2 (call did not return negative): when it holds, return v4; otherwise fall through to the default result -1.
Return the WCHAR v4 produced by the stream on success, or -1 on failure/sentinel.
Invoked by StreamCreationWithFlagInit (0x0059A3A9) during stream-state initialization.
